name: Bedtime Stretch to Release Tension
equipment: A bed or mat, and comfortable clothing
instructions: Do a short, gentle stretch sequence in bed -- physical tension from the day often keeps the mind from settling too.
Focus on slow, held stretches (20-30 seconds each) rather than anything active; the goal is calming down, not working out.
Breathe slowly through your nose throughout -- long exhales signal your nervous system to shift out of "alert" mode.
Follow along with tonight's bedtime yoga video, then move straight into lying down for sleep.
